_about: Animation overhaul, unit F (docs/animation/overhaul-plan.md): idles and transitions with personality. stances: the weight shift (sway in units and rad, hz), the knee bounce (bounce in units, bounce_hz), the heel lift (rad) and the breathing scale of each stance; tiers: scales for the form (index 0 is tier 1: higher forms are calmer, slower and deeper); guard: the arm kicks (rad/s, upper arm then forearm) when the guard comes up (the stance changes to defensive) and when it goes down, and lag, how much later the arms follow the torso while the base pose changes; turn: a turn-around is a step, not a flip (dur in s, dip in units, swing and twist in rad). Render only, outside the sim's data hash.
